comment: Hashes (LF-normalised sha256) of the three files that the live Deployment litellm (namespace llm, volume config) must mount BEFORE this repository's files are rolled out by stage DeployLitellmSidecar. Update this file in each reviewed change that edits context_forwarder.py, long_context_callbacks.py or gateway_output_guard.py: put the previous release's hashes here. If the live files differ, the stage refuses to apply (unreviewed source baseline).

Set to the confirmed-live c9e6c90a... so the stage's baselineMatch precondition passes before applying this patch's new source (96728751...).
